dialogues.speaker: Xbalanque
dialogues.text: Is that Ochkanatlan? Ahh... Sure brings back memories.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh yeah! That was built in your time, right?

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: It's long become a landmark. Very popular with tourists, so I hear — they think it's a lovely place.

dialogues.speaker: Xbalanque
dialogues.text: Is that so? So that's how you all see it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon thinks so too! It's especially stunning if you look at it from a Spiritway.

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: The stories of the past become things people aspire to in the future. It's just like what they say — the apex reached by those who came before will become the everyday goals of those who come after. Everything is constantly changing for the better.

dialogues.speaker: Xbalanque
dialogues.text: That's good. That's how it should be. I'll bring those words back to the Night Kingdom, and share them with everyone there.
